hooks.name: Environment Validation Check
hooks.description: Checks if .env exists and has required API keys configured on session start

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "if (!(Test-Path '.env')) { Write-Output 'WARNING: .env file not found. AI enrichment features (Gemini API) will not work. Create .env from .env.example with your API keys.'; exit 0 } $content = Get-Content '.env' -Raw; if ($content -notmatch 'GEMINI_API_KEY=(?!your_)') { Write-Output 'WARNING: GEMINI_API_KEY not configured in .env. AI features disabled. Add your key to .env file.' }; exit 0"
